theorems.name: Submission.allard52_tangent_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U, AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, V.HasDensity x (V.mult x))
